text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis (AIN)

The urinalysis shows leukocyturia and, crucially, binucleated eosinophilic cells, which are classic indicators of an allergic reaction in the kidney. Given your recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis followed by flank pain and fever, this strongly points to drug-induced AIN rather than a standard bacterial infection like pyelonephritis.
